fields.title: Column selection
fields.description: The numerical columns to be used for clustering.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Number of clusters
fields.description: The number of clusters (cluster centers) to be created.

fields.title: Centroid initialization
fields.description: Determine how the initial centroids (cluster centers) are chosen.

fields.title: Use static random seed
fields.description: When checked, uses the provided static seed for reproducible random centroid initialization.

fields.title: Seed value
fields.description: The seed value for random centroid initialization.

fields.title: New
fields.description: Generate a new random seed value.

fields.title: Max number of iterations
fields.description: The maximum number of iterations after which the algorithm terminates if it hasn't found a stable solution before.

fields.title: Enable Hilite Mapping
fields.description: If enabled, the hiliting of a cluster row (2nd output) will hilite all rows of this cluster in the input table and the 1st output table. Depending on the number of rows, enabling this feature might consume a lot of memory.
